assumptions.obligation: Resets are asserted together: when i_rst_n_mst falls (global clock), i_rst_n_slv is low in the same step; mst reset is never asserted alone
Resets are asserted together: when i_rst_n_slv falls (global clock), i_rst_n_mst is low in the same step; slv reset is never asserted alone
i_rst_n_mst is released synchronously to i_clk_mst: it rises only in the same global step as a rising edge of i_clk_mst
i_rst_n_slv is released synchronously to i_clk_slv: it rises only in the same global step as a rising edge of i_clk_slv
The requester keeps i_apb_psel low while either reset is asserted; no transfer starts before both resets are released
After the one-cycle Setup phase the requester holds PSEL and PENABLE high until the PREADY cycle; no new Setup before PREADY
APB5 only: once i_apb_pwakeup is high in a cycle with i_apb_psel, it stays high until o_apb_pready
